recommendation: Keep the source fix. Treat FHIR-53092 as the later governing removal decision, already represented on the combined branch, and avoid reintroducing duplicate accession identifiers in future examples.
issue_request: FHIR-44755 asked to treat Specimen.accessionIdentifier as an Identifier, guide use of Identifier.type ACSN for accession identifiers, and temporarily require any accessionIdentifier value to also appear in Specimen.identifier while seeking ballot feedback on eventual removal.
initial_application: FHIR-44755 source commits added ACSN-typed Specimen.identifier examples and a temporary spm-2 invariant, with Jira later citing PR #3496 commit f4b98d0. That application was present, but after later removal of accessionIdentifier the isolate, pooled-serum, and urine examples retained exact duplicate ACSN identifier blocks.
additional_context: FHIR-53092 later removed Specimen.accessionIdentifier, spm-2, and the accession search parameter for R6 while retaining the ACSN guidance on Specimen.identifier. A combined-branch FHIR-53092 reconcile commit already fixed remaining non-specimen-folder uses, so this reconciliation only addresses the duplicate examples left in active source/specimen inputs.
reconciliation: Deleted the second of each identical ACSN-typed Identifier pair in source/specimen/specimen-example-isolate.xml, source/specimen/specimen-example-pooled-serum.xml, and source/specimen/specimen-example-urine.xml. Each affected Specimen still carries the accession number once as Identifier.type ACSN.
source_changes: source/specimen/specimen-example-isolate.xml: removed duplicate ACSN identifier blocks from the root isolate specimen and its contained stool specimen.
source/specimen/specimen-example-pooled-serum.xml: removed the duplicate ACSN identifier block for accession 20171120-1234.
source/specimen/specimen-example-urine.xml: removed the duplicate ACSN identifier block for accession X352356.
